# Feature: Skill Progression v2 — Domain + Persistence (2/3)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-02 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent

Issue #90: Implement source-aware skill progression (7 free / 2 background / 1 archetype start points, stacked background points, level 3–19 skill advances, multiple specializations with provenance) in the SagaDrive rules kernel and character domain layer after architecture migration #94. Deterministic calculation, fail-closed validation for new provenance, legacy read compatibility without invented level events. UI redesign is #91 out of scope.

## Preconditions

- Branch from `main` with merged #94 architecture, #96 hardening, #97 boundary-check P2.
- Canonical rules from #89 / PR #93 documented in `docs/sagadrive core rules.md`.
- Character persistence remains owner-scoped via Supabase adapter; no React/Supabase in rules kernel.

## Happy Path

- [ ] Rules kernel exposes `getExperienceBonus`, `getAppliedExperienceBonus`, `getSkillCap`, `getSkillAdvanceLevels`, start-source validate/apply, advance validate/apply, final rank resolve, specialization validate — all deterministic for levels 1–20.
- [ ] New profile fields persist `freeSkillRanks`, `backgroundSkillPoints` (1|2 per skill), `skillAdvances`, `specializations` with source + acquiredAtLevel; legacy `trainedSkills[]` maps exactly to `+1/+1`.
- [ ] Level-1 build: background `medicine:+2` + archetype `medicine:+1` → medicine rank 3; roundtrip load/save preserves provenance.
- [ ] Level-5 advance `medicine 3→4` stored as level-5 event; caps enforced per level band.
- [ ] Level 17: applied EB for ranks 0/1/2/3/4/5 → 0/2/3/4/5/5; initiative uses applied EB on awareness; health/resistances use global EB.
- [ ] `assertValidSagaDriveSkillPersistence` fail-closed when new provenance present but final `skills` mismatch; skipped for legacy-unresolved characters.
- [ ] Architecture boundary check passes; `npm run test-gate` green including new regression script.

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Background `{medicine:2}` and `{medicine:1, insight:1}` valid; sum ≠ 2 or skill outside pool invalid.
- [ ] Combined start sources producing rank 4 at level 1 invalid; four trained start skills legal.
- [ ] Skill advance on capped skill or duplicate level slot invalid.
- [ ] Legacy `trainedSkills:[a,b]` → `a:+1,b:+1` never `a:+2`.
- [ ] Legacy final ranks without reconstructable provenance preserved; no fictional level events.
- [ ] Background specialization lost when last background point removed → invalid/reset path documented.

## Regression

- [ ] Attribute progression persistence unchanged.
- [ ] Character editor still loads/saves (UI may use legacy skill UX until #91).
- [ ] Existing architecture-boundary-check and character-editor regression checks pass.

## Security Coverage

- B-01/B-04: Skill validation enforced server-side in `assert-character-persistence` before Supabase write; no client-only trust.
- B-07/B-08: No permission/route changes in this slice.
- F-03: No new user-input rendering paths.
- Legacy normalization does not silently upgrade `+1/+1` to `+2`; invalid new provenance throws on save.

## Assumptions

- `freeSkillRanks` stored on `sagaDriveProfile` (not separate table); JSONB additive fields only.
- Background specialization remains in `background.specialization` at level 1; full list also in `specializations[]` when provenance complete.
- `SAGA_DRIVE_START_MIN_TRAINED_SKILLS` remains in UI until #91; domain removes min-6 requirement.
